title: CaqhCredentialingSnapshotResponse
description: The newest stored CAQH credentialing profile for a provider

attestationDate.description: Date the provider attested this version of the profile (YYYY-MM-DD)

retrievedAt.description: When CertifyOS retrieved this profile from CAQH (ISO-8601, UTC). Null for profiles stored before the retrieval time was recorded.

data.description: The CAQH profile exactly as received from CAQH, field names unchanged. Every value is a string. SSN is masked unless PII view is granted.
